title.narrative: ICRC - Strategic support through the Danish Red Cross from 2022

description.narrative:
The overall objective for the annual strategic support to the ICRC channeled through the DRC is to support ICRC country operations in humanitarian emergencies as well as maximizing effective and locally driven humanitarian responses through a strengthened partnership and collaboration between DRC and ICRC on Branch Development, Rapid Response Mechanism and other common strategic priority areas.
The DRC plays an important role in promoting humanitarian principles and delivering humanitarian assistance around the world. The DRC and the MFA agree on the continued strategic benefit of the funding to the ICRC channeled through the DRC, which contributes to the enhanced and strong partnership between the DRC and the ICRC in emergencies around localisation and other common strategic priorities, and in support of the Danish Humanitarian and Development strategy, “The World We Share”.
The partner’s results description and results frameworks are global, general, and highly aggregated and the MFA core contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.icrc.org/en/what-we-do
